description:
A voltage-dependent ZIP load, most commonly used for dynamics modeling.

A `StandardLoad` breaks the ZIP into three pieces: Z (constant impedance), I (constant current), and P (constant power), according to `P = P_P * V^0 + P_I * V^1 + P_Z * V^2` for active power and `Q = Q_P * V^0 + Q_I * V^1 + Q_Z * V^2` for reactive power. (Voltage V is in per unit.)

For an alternative exponential formulation of the ZIP model, see `ExponentialLoad`. For a simpler load model with no voltage dependency, see `PowerLoad`.

id.description: Unique integer identifier for this component.

name.description: Name of the component. Components of the same type (e.g., `PowerLoad`) must have unique names, but components of different types (e.g., `PowerLoad` and `ACBus`) can have the same name.

available.description: Indicator of whether the component is connected and online (`true`) or disconnected, offline, or down (`false`). Unavailable components are excluded during simulations.

bus.description: ID of the bus that this component is connected to.

base_power.description: Base power of the load for per unitization.

impedance_active_power.description: Active power coefficient for constant impedance load (P_Z).

impedance_reactive_power.description: Reactive power coefficient for constant impedance load (Q_Z).

current_active_power.description: Active power coefficient for constant current load (P_I).

current_reactive_power.description: Reactive power coefficient for constant current load (Q_I).

max_constant_active_power.description: Maximum active power drawn by constant power load.

max_constant_reactive_power.description: Maximum reactive power drawn by constant power load.

max_impedance_active_power.description: Maximum active power drawn by constant impedance load.

max_impedance_reactive_power.description: Maximum reactive power drawn by constant impedance load.

max_current_active_power.description: Maximum active power drawn by constant current load.

max_current_reactive_power.description: Maximum reactive power drawn by constant current load.

conformity.description: Indicates whether the specified load is conforming or non-conforming.

title: StandardLoad
